column4: NVIDIA EGLStream platform has no identified consumer on the Pi V3D desktop; it is not a generic Wayland EGL dependency.
gtk-launch runtime used by the installed application launcher.
Standard desktop notification client runtime and notify-send utility.
Layer-shell support used by compatible GTK desktop components; verify at deployment.

Pi graphics userspace baseline for the V3D/DRM stack; preserve the existing firmware and overlay.
Policy daemon required by the Quickshell authentication agent; verify agent/session integration at deployment.

ALSA compatibility for the audio baseline.
